title: Manager - Data Steward
description:
Join our team and you will have an opportunity to work in a collaborative and dynamic environment. This newly created role will join a team of data professionals focused on advancing data management capabilities and strengthening data as a strategic asset.
  
  
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
  
  
**What role will you play?**
In this role, as a Data Steward, you will play a critical part in ensuring the integrity, quality, and governance of data across the organization for data delivered through Macquarie’s central data warehouse and Data Hub. You will work across business and technology teams to develop a clear understanding of critical data, its business meaning, ownership, source, transformation, lineage, quality, and usage. You will partner with data owners, subject matter experts, data producers, architects, and consumers to maintain trusted data, identify governance gaps, and coordinate practical remediation. You will also support the consistent adoption of data governance standards, metadata management, data lineage, data quality, and ownership practices across FPE data domains. This is an exciting opportunity to work closely with stakeholders across various levels, ensuring compliance with data governance principles and supporting the delivery of best practices in data management.
  
  
**What You Offer**

* 6 to 9 years overall experience, with 5 plus years’ experience in data stewardship, data governance, data quality, metadata management, data lineage, data management along with strong understanding of end-to-end data flows, including data sourcing, transformation, storage, provisioning, reporting, and consumption.
* Bachelors or master’s in finance, Mathematics, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline or qualified CA, ACCA.

* Experience identifying data quality, lineage, ownership, metadata, and control gaps and coordinating remediation activities.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and issue investigation is preferred
* Experience with data governance and metadata tools such as Collibra, along with Jira and Confluence along with familiarity with Power BI, data warehouse concepts, data models, and enterprise data platforms is desirable.
* Strong Stakeholder management skills along with ability to prepare governance reporting and communicate risks and remediation progress
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare governance reporting and communicate risks and remediation progress.

title: Senior Analyst, AI & Data Strategy-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Analyst, AI & Data Strategy-1
  
  
Sr. Analyst, Master Data Management
  
  
Location: Gurgaon, India
  
  
Reports to: Vice President, Master Data Management
  
  
**About The Position**
The Sr. Analyst of Master Data Management (MDM) is responsible for execution of Mastercard’s MDM strategy across the enterprise. This role is instrumental in shaping and implementing the strategic vision for MDM initiatives, ensuring alignment with broader enterprise data governance goals.
  
  
In close partnership with business and technology stakeholders, the Sr. Analyst will operationalize MDM and governance practices to uphold the consistency, accuracy, and integrity of mastered data assets. This role demands strong cross-functional collaboration with stakeholders across Franchise, Product, Corporate, Mastercard Technology, and global business units to drive and sustain the data management strategy.
  
  
As a subject matter expert in master and reference data management, this individual will represent the Office of the Chief Data Officer (CDO) in executing MDM best practices to promote enterprise-wide data excellence.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design & Implementation: Design and implement Master Data Management (MDM) solutions aligned with strategic business objectives and guided by leadership direction. Key responsibilities include gathering requirements, architecting solutions, configuring platforms such as Reltio, and maintaining ongoing operations. This role also oversees system upgrades, migrations, and new deployments, ensuring timely execution of MDM initiatives while fostering continuous improvement in data management practices.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a liaison between IT, business stakeholders, and data governance teams to ensure seamless integration and adoption of MDM solutions across enterprise systems (e.g., Merchant data platform, Oracle Financials, Coupa, Salesforce, Mastercard Billing System).
* Data Quality & Governance: Partner with the data quality team to streamline data profiling, cleansing, enrichment, and lifecycle management. Monitor and report on data quality KPIs. Partner with governance teams to establish and enforce standards, frameworks, and best practices across master data domains (e.g., merchant, customer, consumer, product, supplier, legal entity).
* Automation & Integration: Drive automation of data ingestion and mastered data consumption processes. Ensure integration of MDM solutions with enterprise applications, Mastercard product and related data pipelines.
* Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure adherence to data privacy, quality, and regulatory requirements while building global solutions.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: Demonstrated experience in Master Data Management (MDM) roles within large enterprise environments, with a minimum of 3 years of relevant MDM experience and at least 1 full-cycle MDM implementations. Proven hands-on expertise in large-scale MDM platforms such as Reltio or Informatica, along with familiarity with data warehousing, analytics and ERP systems.
* Technical & Analytical Skills: Experienced data professional with strong problem-solving skills and expertise in enterprise data products and architecture. Proficient in Hadoop, Databricks, RDBMS, SQL, Alteryx, and Excel. Skilled in data integration, metadata management, and taxonomy modeling. Adept at designing scalable data platforms, including data lakes, warehouses, lakehouses, and real-time pipelines. Proven ability to lead data strategy and unify fragmented ecosystems in complex organizations.
* Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with master data domains relevant to the financial services and technology industries—such as merchant, customer, consumer, product, and financial master data—is preferred.
* Leadership: Implement MDM and governance frameworks, collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive change.
* Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills. Demonstrated success in stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration.
* Mindset: Self-starter with a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution. Ability to deliver results under tight deadlines.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Introduction To Team**
Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travelers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.
  
  
The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.
  
  
We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.
  
  
As a Senior SDE, you will set the technical direction for core Data Quality Platform services and drive their design, delivery, and operation end to end. You will be a hands-on technical leader—writing and reviewing code, shaping architecture across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, and data health experiences, and raising the engineering bar for the team. Your work will directly determine how effectively engineering, analytics, and data teams across Expedia Group can trust and act on their data at scale.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design, build, and maintain complex, highly available Data Quality Platform services and applications, including robust system design (low-level design), API design (REST/gRPC), and data modeling across batch and streaming domains.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of features and services—from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization in production—spanning profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, and alerting.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by driving code quality standards, reducing incidents, strengthening observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost of high-throughput data systems.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and distributed-systems architecture, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, data platform teams, and data domain owners to translate business and data-trust problems into scalable technical solutions that can be reused across domains.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled and machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying AI/ML concepts to practical data platform workflows.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 8+ years of professional backend software development experience in an object-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end-to-end delivery for services or components—including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support—within a multi-service or domain environment.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language and core software engineering practices, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control.
* Hands-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable and maintainable systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low-level designs.
* Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including integration with batch or streaming pipelines (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Airflow) and backward-compatible APIs.
* Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, or analytics systems, or a closely related domain.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data-informed tradeoffs on scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, SRE practices, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, including safely integrating AI/ML-enabled features into existing services.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and mentoring others to grow their technical depth and delivery capability—including guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI-assisted development and testing tools.

**Accommodation requests**
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Cloud Administrator
description:
This role is technical in nature and focuses on building and maintaining Microsoft SQL Server and Postgres databases. You will be responsible for the delivery of database support services to FNZ platforms hosted in public cloud environments (Azure and AWS), through Infrastructure as Code pipelines and manual builds.

The Cloud Infrastructure team is small, and each team member is given the opportunity to own significant parts of the solution end to end. The Cloud DBA is expected to work with the Cloud Engineers to develop the best possible database solution for our internal stakeholders to do our part in delivering customer success.

**Team Responsibilities: -**

1. Automate the design, build, and maintenance of database environments to ensure high availability and scalability.
2. Use monitoring tools to optimize performance and proactively resolve issues.
3. Implement automated backup and disaster recovery pipelines to protect critical data.
4. Enforce security through automated user and access management.
5. Diagnose and resolve performance issues using modern diagnostic tools.
6. Leverage cloud-native automation to scale storage and manage capacity efficiently.

**Specific Role Responsibilities:-**

* Maintain and monitor Azure and AWS database services to ensure high availability and performance.
* Troubleshoot issues, optimize queries, and meet performance SLAs.
* Implement and manage backups, failover solutions, and disaster recovery plans.
* Enforce security protocols and manage access controls.
* Collaborate with the cloud engineering team to design, build, and run pipelines that automate database build and maintenance tasks.
* Support database builds and project delivery while working closely with developers to optimize performance.
* Participate in a global on-call support roster to address critical issues and maintain service reliability.
* Stay updated on Azure and AWS technologies and share knowledge with the team.
* Manage incident, problem and change management via FNZs ticketing solution.
* Participate in risk management and information security initiatives, supporting internal and external audits.
* Manage escalations to the appropriate stakeholders.

**Performance Assessment**

* Uptime and performance metrics in Azure and AWS
* Quality of security documentation and adherence to cloud security standards.
* Backup and recovery test results, and DR plan performance in cloud environments.
* Project timelines, quality metrics, and cost efficiency.

**Experience Required**

* Required2+ years of experience as a Database Administrator in Azure and/or AWS environments.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL, including database design and optimization.
* Demonstrated ability or strong interest in working within dynamic, high-availability environments. Exposure to or eagerness to learn about mission-critical systems is highly valued.
* Proven ability to work as an individual, with excellent self-management and time management skills.
* Ability to participate in an on-call roster and perform some work outside normal business hours.

title: Software Development Engineer 2
description:
**Company Description**

NikahForever is India’s most trusted Muslim Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. With
**65,000+ success stories**
and over
**2 Million+ members,**
we are committed to fostering strong connections and building a better community. Our AI-based algorithm ensures seamless profile searches and connections, transforming the way people approach marriage. Based in India, NikahForever has created a user-friendly platform where finding your life partner happens in just three steps: Register, Search, and Connect.

**About the Role**

You'll take unclear problems and turn them into reliable, production-grade systems. You won't get a detailed spec. You'll get a problem, context, and the freedom to decide how to solve it. You'll own the full lifecycle: understanding the problem, designing, building, shipping, monitoring and iterating.

We're AI-native. You'll use coding agents and agentic workflows daily to move faster, and you stay fully accountable for everything you ship.

We don't hire based on familiarity with a particular programming language, framework, or technology stack.
**We value strong fundamentals, problem-solving ability, learning speed, engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver working software.**

**What You'll Do**

* Own features and services end to end, from discovery and design through deployment and monitoring
* Work across backend, data, infrastructure, integrations and AI-powered workflows, depending on what the problem needs
* Make and defend architectural trade-offs (performance, cost, complexity, speed)
* Debug production failures, find root causes, and improve observability and resilience
* Build internal tools and automations that remove repetitive engineering work
* Prototype quickly, validate assumptions, and turn what works into production code
* Use AI agents, tool calling and MCP integrations to compress delivery cycles, and review their output critically
* Raise the bar on code quality and engineering practices through your own work and reviews

**Must have**

* 2-4 years building and running production software
* Strong fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, databases, OS/networking basics, concurrency, system design
* Experience across more than one domain, such as backend/APIs, data-heavy systems, queues and async processing, cloud and deployment, third-party integrations, or AI/LLM applications
* Comfort entering an unfamiliar codebase and learning a new language or tool when the problem demands it
* Hands-on use of AI coding tools, and the judgment to catch hallucinations and hidden failure modes in generated code
* A track record of finishing things: shipping, then fixing, then measuring impact

**Strong plus**

* Experience at a product company or on a high-scale system
* Performance, reliability or data-consistency work with measurable results
* Internal tools, automation, or agent-based workflows you've built
* Frontend or mobile exposure
* B.Tech/B.E. in CS, IT, ECE, EE or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program

**How You'll Be Evaluated**

1. **Resume and work review:**
   a conversation about what you personally built and the measurable impact
2. **Practical coding round:**
   write, debug and test code under realistic constraints
3. **System design:**
   an open-ended design problem sized to a real scale
4. **AI-assisted build:**
   solve a task with an AI agent while we watch how you steer, verify and test
5. **Hiring manager conversation:**
   your hardest problems, failures, and what you learned

**Why Join**

* Real ownership and direct business impact from week one
* Exposure across stacks and domains
* Hands-on experience building with AI agents on production systems

**Apply Now!**

Codians is looking for an experienced L2 Operations Engineer – Database (DBA) to manage, support, and maintain enterprise databases hosted on public cloud platforms.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Oracle Database, Microsoft SQL Server, and cloud database services, preferably on AWS. The role involves database administration, production incident management, patching, backup and recovery, performance tuning, capacity planning, and database security in a 24×7 operations environment.

 • Manage database incidents end to end, from L1/L1.5 escalation through resolution and closure, following documented runbooks and SOPs.

 • Monitor database and infrastructure alerts, troubleshoot issues, and escalate complex incidents to L3 support when required.

 • Participate in on-call and shift rotations to support 24×7 operations.

 • Install, configure, and provision database instances on AWS EC2 and managed database services.

 • Perform database patching, minor upgrades, migrations, and fix-pack deployments according to client schedules.

 • Execute database backups and restores, including point-in-time recovery, and participate in disaster recovery testing.

 • Troubleshoot backup failures, database job failures, storage issues, and space alerts.

 • Perform SQL and database performance tuning, including schema and index optimization.

 • Conduct routine database health checks and support capacity planning and cost-optimization initiatives.

 • Manage database access, security and audit logs in accordance with established guidelines.

 • Maintain database inventory and ensure alignment with the Configuration Management Database (CMDB).

 • Develop scripts to automate routine database administration tasks.

 • Raise and implement changes through the client's change management process.

 • Maintain accurate ServiceNow tickets, resolution notes, and closure documentation.

 • Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reviews and update SOPs and knowledge-base articles.

 • Support migration to cloud-managed database services and decommission databases according to established procedures.

 • Perform Oracle E-Business Suite patching and development/test cloning where applicable.

 • Required Technical Skills

 • Databases: Oracle Database, Microsoft SQL Server

 • Cloud Platforms: AWS (preferred); Azure and GCP are also acceptable

 • Cloud Database Services: Amazon RDS, Aurora, and equivalent managed database services

 • Backup & Recovery: RMAN, AWS Backup/Snapshots, Quest LiteSpeed

 • Monitoring: Datadog and cloud-native monitoring tools

 • ITSM: ServiceNow

 • Scripting: SQL, PL/SQL, PowerShell, Shell scripting, or Python

 • Core Expertise: Database administration, patching, upgrades, backup and recovery, performance tuning, capacity planning, security, and audit management

 • Preferred Technical Exposure

 • PostgreSQL

 • Amazon DocumentDB

 • OpenSearch

 • Oracle E-Business Suite

 • Databricks and Google BigQuery

 • Database cost optimization and FinOps practices

 • Required Experience & Qualifications

 • 6–9 years of hands-on database administration experience.

 • Recent experience managing cloud database infrastructure on IaaS and PaaS/managed services.

 • Strong experience with Oracle and/or Microsoft SQL Server administration.

 • Experience working in a 24×7 production support environment.

 • Knowledge of ITSM incident, problem, and change management processes.

 • Experience with database patching, backup and recovery, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.

 • Good written and spoken English communication skills.

 • Flexibility to participate in on-call and shift rotations.

 • Preferred Certification

 • AWS foundational certification, such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, or an equivalent certification.

 Interested Candidates?

If your experience matches this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you!

Share your updated resume via LinkedIn DM or mail us at tech@codians.ai

Job Description – Platform Engineer

**Job Title:**
Platform Engineer
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

Work Location: KSA

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced
**Platform Engineer**
to support the installation, configuration, integration, and operationalization of an on-premises modern data platform. The role will focus on infrastructure setup, platform administration, security integration, environment management, and platform reliability across Development, QA, and Production environments.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience deploying enterprise data platforms in highly secured environments, with strong troubleshooting, operational support, and infrastructure management capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, and administer data platform components in an on-premises environment
* Deploy and manage
  **MinIO Object Storage**
  and
  **Apache Iceberg**

* Install, configure, and optimize
  **Starburst**
  and/or
  **Dremio**
  platforms for data virtualization and querying
* Deploy, administer, and support
  **Apache Spark**
  clusters and processing services
* Install, configure, and manage
  **Informatica**
  components and ensure seamless integration with the platform ecosystem
* Configure and maintain Development, QA, and Production environments
* Integrate platform components with enterprise security services, including:
  + Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  + Privileged Access Management (PAM)
  + Active Directory / LDAP
  + Single Sign-On (SSO) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
* Implement and support Git-based DevOps and CI/CD practices
* Manage monitoring, logging, backup, disaster recovery, and operational readiness processes
* Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and application teams to ensure platform stability, availability, and performance
* Troubleshoot deployment, configuration, integration, and connectivity issues across the platform stack

Must-Have Skills

* MinIO Administration
* Apache Iceberg
* Starburst and/or Dremio Administration
* Apache Spark Administration
* Informatica Administration
* Linux System Administration
* VMware Infrastructure
* Docker and/or Kubernetes
* Git and CI/CD Integration
* IAM/PAM Integration
* Infrastructure Troubleshooting and Operational Support

Good-to-Have Skills

* Data Lakehouse Architecture
* Enterprise Security Architecture
* Performance Tuning and Capacity Planning

* Experience working in highly secured enterprise environments
* Disaster Recovery and Backup Strategy Implementation

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Meet the Team**
Join a team that's helping some of the world's largest enterprises successfully deploy AI into production. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you'll work at the intersection of software engineering, customer engagement, and product innovation. You'll partner closely with customers to solve complex technical challenges while collaborating with Product and Engineering teams to improve the platform based on real-world customer needs.
  
  
You'll work on some of the most challenging AI deployments in the industry, partnering with Fortune 100 organizations to bring cutting-edge AI systems into production. Every engagement influences not only customer success, but also the future direction of the product. If you enjoy solving hard engineering problems, working directly with customers, and building technology that scales beyond a single implementation, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**As a Forward Deployed Engineer, You Will**

* Partner with enterprise customers to understand technical requirements and business goals.
* Design scalable AI solution architectures and guide customers through production deployments.
* Build integrations, prototypes, and reusable tools that accelerate customer success.
* Lead technical workshops, architecture discussions, and troubleshoot complex production issues.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to share customer feedback and influence future product enhancements.
* Create documentation, reusable best practices, and technical assets that benefit future deployments.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* 7+ years of strong software engineering experience building production-grade applications, or Masters + 4 years of related experience, or PhD + 1 year of related experience.
* Experience with APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or backend development.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across multiple layers of the technology stack.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with enterprise customers.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Interest in AI, Machine Learning, or developer platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying or supporting Generative AI, LLM, or Machine Learning applications in production.
* Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, observability, or MLOps.
* Experience building customer-facing technical solutions or integrations.
* Experience creating reusable developer tools, frameworks, or open-source contributions.
* Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Customer Success experience in enterprise environments.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer L5
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.
  
  
Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.
  
  
Who You Are
  
  
You are a Software Engineer L5 with deep experience building scalable software and data-driven systems that power analytics, business intelligence, and reporting for clients. You will work within the engineering organization to design resilient, secure, and high-performance distributed systems that support critical business outcomes. In this role, you will apply sound architectural judgment, technical leadership, and strong collaboration to influence platform direction and improve engineering excellence across teams. Your work will help deliver reliable solutions that strengthen Inovalon’s infrastructure and client reporting capabilities.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Design resilient, secure distributed systems and services that scale effectively to support analytics, business intelligence, and reporting capabilities for clients.
* Lead architecture and design decisions for new and existing systems, raising the engineering bar for scale, resiliency, and security fundamentals.
* Evaluate, influence, and help establish evolving design patterns, architecture standards, and engineering practices used to build and deliver services and solutions.
* Investigate and implement innovative technologies that expand Inovalon’s infrastructure through robust, scalable solutions.
* Develop and execute designs for complex systems using detailed engineering analysis, sound judgment, and thorough testing and optimization.
* Define, collect, and use metrics to manage server fleets and complex computing environments, driving automation, performance improvements, and operational efficiency.
* Take ownership of detailed system design, analysis, testing, optimization, and issue resolution to ensure reliable delivery and performance.
* Mentor and onboard new team members, supporting successful ramp-up and contributing to team effectiveness.
* Collaborate closely with engineers, internal services across Inovalon, and external customers to understand requirements and maintain a tight, data-driven feedback loop.
* Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical issues outside standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, and respond within defined SLAs.

What You'll Need
  
  

* Minimum 8+ years of related professional experience, with prior software engineering experience preferred, and 2+ years of experience leading the design or architecture of new or existing services and systems, including design patterns, reliability, and scaling.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* Strong programming skills in object-oriented languages, including .NET and C#, with experience in RESTful API development and EF Core mapping.
* Proficiency with Angular and TypeScript.
* Experience working with SQL, RDS, and DynamoDB.
* Solid understanding of software and database design patterns.
* Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and system design for performance, scalability, and availability.
* Experience with cloud-native AWS managed services, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD.
* Experience working with OAuth2, JWT, and Secrets Manager.
* Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by quickly learning new technologies, expanding scope, and applying new knowledge to improve systems and team outcomes.
* Demonstrate leadership by influencing technical decisions, collaborating across engineering and customer stakeholders, mentoring others, and constructively navigating differing viewpoints.
* Demonstrate adaptability by adjusting priorities and approaches in response to changing requirements, operational needs, and evolving technologies while staying focused on results.
* Demonstrate creative thinking by identifying practical, innovative ways to solve infrastructure, scalability, and reporting challenges.
* Demonstrate analytical skills by using metrics, engineering analysis, and data to diagnose issues, evaluate tradeoffs, and inform technical decisions.
* Nice to have: [CONFIRM: preferred qualifications]

Our Shared Commitments
  
  

* Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement.
* Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position.
* Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer.

Work Environment
  
  

* This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.

*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)*
*If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
*By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.*
*Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement.*

****Why join us at Nural****

Nural is a 2020-founded B2B SaaS company building the Nural One suite (Sales, Service, Assets and Analytics) used by field and operations teams at recognised brands including Motorola, Sony, Kohler, LAVA, Nothing and Fiserv.

As an Infra Support Engineer, you won’t be a small cog watching tickets pile up — you’ll own the infrastructure that keeps these products live, fast and reliable for real enterprise customers, every single day.

We’re a small, flat, fast-moving team, so the systems you strengthen and the calls you make on uptime, deployments and security are visible and valued from day one — with plenty of room to pick up cloud, DevOps and automation skills as we scale.

******Job Overview******

We’re looking for an Infra Support Engineer to manage and support the Windows-based application infrastructure, IIS servers, databases, deployments, monitoring and CI/CD activities that keep Nural’s products running. You’ll work closely with our development and application teams to maintain uptime, troubleshoot infrastructure issues fast, and keep deployments smooth and safe — a role with real ownership and a direct line of sight to the customers who depend on what you support.

**Infrastructure & Application Support**

* Manage and monitor Windows Servers and IIS application environments.
* Perform application deployments and support QA, staging, and production environments.
* Manage server/application configuration and environment-related changes.
* Perform server health checks and assist with infrastructure maintenance.

**Monitoring & Troubleshooting**

* Perform basic SQL Server database troubleshooting and connectivity checks.
* Monitor and troubleshoot SQL Server Agent jobs and scheduled jobs.
* Support database connectivity issues using SSMS.

**Network, DNS & Security**

* Manage and troubleshoot DNS and SSL/certificate-related issues.
* Work with Cloudflare and GoDaddy DNS configurations.
* Follow security, backup, access-control, and change-management procedures.

**Documentation**

* Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

**Preferred Skills**

* Jenkins / Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions
* Docker
* AWS / Azure
* Terraform
* Kubernetes
* PowerShell scripting
* Monitoring and logging tools

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.

**How to Apply**

Send your resume to hr@nuraltech.com with the subject line “Infra Support Engineer”, or apply directly via nuraltech.com/careers.

title: Global Product Senior Specialist - FDP 360 Platform
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a
**Product Analyst**
on the Business Intelligence & Analytics Change Team, you will help integrate new Finance applications and analytical capabilities into BCG’s enterprise data warehouse and digital products, partnering with Business Intelligence & Analytics Change Team subject matter experts to understand business needs, reporting requirements, and the capabilities needed to support effective decision-making.
  
  
Once requirements are defined, you will work closely with Solution Architects and Developers and independently lead implementation through design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. A key part of your role will be testing and validating data in Snowflake and BI reports to ensure solutions meet defined business and reporting requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities Would Include**

* Partner with SMEs to gather, clarify, and document business and reporting requirements.
* Translate business requirements into technical requirements, data needs, and implementation plans.
* Lead implementation with Solution Architects and Developers, coordinating work through delivery.
* Analyze gaps between required analytical capabilities and Finance application data models.
* Develop and recommend solution options for review and decision by the Product Owner and SMEs.
* Define source-to-target data mappings and models that support scalable analysis and reporting.
* Test and validate data in Snowflake and BI reports, identifying discrepancies and ensuring solutions meet defined requirements.
* Analyze data anomalies and gaps in business logic, determine root causes, and coordinate resolution of BI reporting issues through the ServiceNow ticketing system.
* Support global users and partner with technical teams to troubleshoot and resolve data and reporting issues.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 3–5 years of experience in business intelligence, Finance reporting, data analytics, or related work.
* Hands-on Snowflake experience querying, analyzing, testing, and validating data.
* Experience with SAP BusinessObjects or comparable enterprise BI and reporting solutions.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to analyze complex data issues, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience translating business requirements into technical requirements and working with technical teams through implementation.
* Clear communication and collaboration skills for working effectively across global, cross-functional teams.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As a member of the Business Intelligence & Analytics Change Team, you will work closely with the Product Owner and subject matter experts to understand business and reporting needs, partnering with Solution Architects and Developers to translate those needs into scalable data and reporting solutions. You will also collaborate with Finance teams, Finance application owners, other Business Intelligence & Analytics teams, and global end users. As BCG’s BI environment evolves, you will work across existing SAP BusinessObjects reporting and emerging platforms, including Power BI and Sigma.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
*"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."*

title: Staff Engineer
description:
The database market is massive (IDC estimates it to be $121B+ by 2026!) and MongoDB is at the head of its disruption. At MongoDB we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing apps that people use every day. We are the leading modern data platform and the first database provider to IPO in over 20 years. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.
  
  
MongoDB is building a world-class team in India to create tooling that helps customers migrate their data from legacy relational databases to MongoDB in real-time. As companies modernise their application and data ecosystems, they are increasingly drawn to the flexibility and scalability of the document model. The tools developed by the Data Migration team are critical in this journey, helping customers with initial data loads, and continuous data synchronization.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Staff Engineer with experience in the Java ecosystem, streaming systems, and data-intensive applications to join our team. We are building a sophisticated data migration suite using a modern technology stack, which includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Debezium. A successful candidate will be a key contributor to our backend services, collaborating closely with product management and other engineers to design and implement cutting-edge products that solve complex customer challenges.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
The ideal candidate for this role will have
  
  

* 8+ years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem
* Extensive experience with streaming data platforms such as Apache Kafka and Change Data Capture (CDC) tools like Debezium
* Extensive experience with relational data modeling and hands-on experience with at least one SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, etc)
* Exposure to client-side technologies such as JavaScript and React is a plus
* Empower the engineering team with unparalleled thought leadership on emerging technologies and best practices
* Proactively engage with product leaders and senior management to align technical solutions with overarching business strategies
* Mentor and guide junior and senior engineers on best practices in data structures, algorithms, and database design

title: Data Migration Engineer (SWP Workstream)
description:
**Req ID:**
390200
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Data Migration Engineer (SWP Workstream) to join our team in Gurgaon, Haryāna (IN-HR), India (IN).
  
  
Role Overview
  
  

* The Senior Data Migration Engineer serves as a hands-on technical contributor and delivery anchor, responsible for designing and implementing Python-based extract/load pipelines, dbt-based transformations, and Airflow-based orchestration for a large-scale migration from Informatica PowerCenter to a modern data stack.
* This role requires deep expertise in converting complex Informatica workflows into Python, dbt, and Airflow, and the ability to deliver production-quality, functionally equivalent output at enterprise scale.Key Responsibilities
* Assess complex Informatica workflows including sessions, mappings, and parameterizations and translate them into equivalent Python EL scripts and dbt transformation models.
* Develop and maintain Python EL pipelines to land high-volume data, including billion-row tables, into the target warehouse using SQLAlchemy, cx\_Oracle, pyodbc, and bulk export tools such as Oracle Data Pump and SQL Server BCP.
* Design and develop dbt transformation models based on Informatica mapping logic, incorporating dbt best practices including model layering, macros, incremental strategies, and snapshot patterns.
* Develop dbt-native tests as well as custom Python unit tests to validate transformation correctness and data quality.
* Develop Airflow DAGs to orchestrate Python EL and dbt scripts end-to-end, producing output that is functionally equivalent to the source Informatica workflows.
* Contribute to GitLab CI/CD pipeline for dbt and Airflow code, including lint gates, automated testing, and deployment to shared NAS.
* Perform peer code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback to fellow engineers.
* Troubleshoot performance issues and data discrepancies during SIT and UAT, including row-count reconciliation between source Oracle/SQL Server systems and the target warehouse.
* Contribute to technical documentation, runbooks, and handover materials.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of Informatica PowerCenter experience - mappings, sessions, workflows, and parameterization
* 3+ years of hands-on dbt Core experience - model layering, macros, tests, incremental materializations
* Any number of years of Airflow experience - DAG authoring, task dependencies, and incorporation with scheduling tool
* 5+ years of Python experience, including production use of parallelism and batch data processing
* 5+ years of SQL experience - complex joins, window functions, aggregations across large datasets
* Experience with Oracle Data Pump (expdp/impdp) or SQL Server BCP / BULK INSERT for high-volume data movement

**Preferred**

* Experience with SQLAlchemy, cx\_Oracle, or pyodbc for Python-based database connectivity
* Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers in offshore delivery models..

* Ensure solutions align with security, data governance, and Salesforce platform best practices
* Leverage AI\-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, GitHub Copilot, and similar capabilities to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation, while using sound judgment around security, accuracy, and responsible AI usage


**Responsibilities**

* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, and implementation best practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Salesforce CPQ Specialist and Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certifications required


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Working knowledge of Salesforce Billing and its underlying data model
* Experience with Salesforce DX, Copado, Gearset, Git\-based workflows, or similar DevOps tooling
* Familiarity with Visualforce, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS
* Experience preparing training materials, supporting UAT/regression testing, and guiding business users through solution adoption
* Practical familiarity with AI\-powered and agentic tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and similar platforms, with the ability to use them thoughtfully to improve delivery speed, analysis, documentation quality, and engineering effectiveness


 Success Measures
   

  

* In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s CPQ implementation, product and pricing structure, Quote\-to\-Cash flows, and stakeholder processes.
* In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver meaningful enhancements across Salesforce CPQ, support key pricing and quoting workflows, and become a dependable contributor to ongoing QTC initiatives.

title: Senior Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Overview**
 Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
   

  

 Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
   

  

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation
   

  

 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “* 
*name@cvent.com* 
*” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*
*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*
*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* 
*https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud* 
*.*
 As a member of
 **Cloud Infrastructure team** 
 , you will design, build, and operate the AWS foundation that underpins Cvent’s products. You will own complex infrastructure services end\-to\-end, drive automation\-first practices, and help evolve our “paved road” for engineers building on AWS.
   

  

 A key focus for this role is to
 **apply AI/ML and AI agents to Cloud Infrastructure operations** 
 – using single and multi‑agent systems and orchestration frameworks to automate diagnostics, runbooks, and workflows while maintaining strong guardrails around security, reliability, and cost.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with Cloud Infrastructure peers, SREs, Security Engineering, and product teams across geographies.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
**Cloud Infrastructure Engineering (AWS)**
* Design, implement, and operate highly available, secure, and scalable AWS infrastructure (e.g., VPC, Transit Gateway, EC2, Load Balancing, S3, EBS/EFS/FSx, Route 53, IAM, KMS, Backup).
* Build and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code using tools such as AWS CDK / CloudFormation, enforcing standards, guardrails, and reusable patterns.
* Develop automation and tooling (primarily in Python/TypeScript) to remove repetitive operational work (provisioning, patching, configuration, cleanup, compliance checks, reporting).
* Contribute to and sometimes lead design reviews, architecture discussions, and RFCs for new or evolving infrastructure services.
* Partner with Security and Compliance to meet security, audit, and regulatory requirements across accounts and regions.


**AI Agents, Orchestration \& Multi‑Agent Systems**
* Identify high‑value Cloud Infra workflows (e.g., incident triage, change impact analysis, runbook execution, capacity/cost recommendations) that can be automated using AI agents.
* Design and implement agentic workflows (single and multi‑agent) using modern AI orchestration patterns and frameworks (e.g., tool‑calling, planners, evaluators, guardrails).
* Integrate agents with existing cloud APIs, observability tools, ticketing systems, and runbooks to provide end‑to‑end, human\-in\-the\-loop automation.
* Define and enforce safety, security, and approval guardrails for AI‑driven actions (RBAC, policy checks, dry‑runs, explicit approvals, audit logging).
* Measure and communicate impact of AI automation (MTTR reduction, hours saved, error reduction, cost optimization, improved engineer experience).


**Reliability, Operations \& On‑Call**
* Own the reliability and performance of services you build – from design through deployment and production operations.
* Implement and tune monitoring, logging, alerting, and SLO/SLA dashboards for Cloud Infra services (Datadog/Splunk/CloudWatch or similar).
* Participate in the on‑call rotation, lead troubleshooting for complex AWS infrastructure incidents, and drive post‑incident reviews and preventative improvements.
* Proactively identify technical debt and reliability risks in infrastructure and drive remediation plans.


**Collaboration, Mentoring \& Best Practices**
* Act as a technical mentor to Engineer I/II teammates on AWS fundamentals, automation patterns, and AI‑driven operations.
* Help define and evolve paved road standards for AWS infrastructure, automation, and AI agent usage across Cloud Infrastructure.
* Contribute to runbooks, design docs, knowledge base articles, and internal training sessions, including AI and automation best practices


**Required Qualifications**
**Here's What You Need:**
* 3–6 years of hands\-on‑ experience in Cloud / Infrastructure Engineering, or similar roles, with strong focus on AWS.
* Deep understanding of core AWS services: VPC \& networking (subnets, routing, TGW, VPN/Direct Connect, security groups, NACLs), EC2, Auto Scaling, Load Balancing, S3, EBS/EFS/FSx, Route 53, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch/CloudTrail, and Backup.
* Strong experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform) and Git\-based workflows (branching, PR reviews, CI/CD).
* Solid programming skills in at least one language commonly used for infra\-automation, such as Python or TypeScript/Node.js.
* Proven track record designing and operating production\-grade, multi‑account/multi‑region AWS environments with a focus on security, reliability, and cost.
* Experience implementing observability for infrastructure services (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards).
* Demonstrated ability to own complex projects end\-to\-end: requirements, design, implementation, rollout, and post‑launch improvements.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills; comfortable working with distributed teams and multiple stakeholders (SRE, Security, product engineering, leadership).


**AI / Agentic Skills – Required**
* Practical experience building or integrating LLM\-based solutions (e.g., using OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure/OpenAI\-compatible, or similar APIs).
* Hands\-on experience with at least one of:
+ AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph\-style, CrewAI\-like, or custom agent patterns), or
+ Orchestrating multi\-step AI workflows using tools, function calling, or custom planners.

* Ability to translate infra problems into agentic workflows (e.g., “given alerts \+ context, generate and execute an actionable runbook; escalate with a summarized context if confidence is low”).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), and techniques to constrain and evaluate AI outputs in production.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in a large\-scale SaaS or multi‑tenant environment.
* Exposure to cost optimization / FinOps in AWS (right‑sizing, storage optimization, data transfer analysis, automated cleanup).
* Experience with security engineering concepts such as least‑privilege IAM design, KMS usage patterns, and network security controls.
* Experience integrating AI agents with ticketing and workflow platforms (Jira/ServiceNow, Slack/MS Teams bots, internal tools).
* AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, Security – Specialty, or Advanced Networking) or equivalent experience.


**Success in This Role**
**In Your First 12–18 Months, Success Looks Like**
* You are a go‑to engineer for complex AWS infrastructure questions in your domain.
* You have delivered at least one or two production AI‑agent workflows that measurably improve Cloud Infra operations (e.g., reduced MTTR, reduced manual toil, or better cost visibility).
* Your infrastructure services are well‑documented, observable, and resilient, with clear runbooks and strong hand‑offs to on‑call engineers.
* You are actively mentoring Engineer I/II teammates and influencing our standards for AWS, automation, and responsible AI usage.


**Cloud Infrastructure**
* Design, develop, and troubleshoot automation jobs for complex workflows across AWS accounts and regions.
* Create and assign Jira tasks to drive progress with clear ownership and follow‑through.
* Create and maintain wiki documentation / README files for workflows, procedures, and tooling enhancements.
* Identify gaps in runbook coverage and author new runbooks that enable repeatable, reliable operations.
* Display mastery of service(s) within a single pillar (e.g., Networking, Compute, Storage, Security, Orchestration).
* Demonstrate competency across multiple pillars, understanding how services interact end‑to‑end.
* Collaborate effectively across CloudOps, SRE, Security, Product Engineering, and other technology teams.


**Cvent Behavioral Competencies**
* Anticipates customer needs and delivers services beyond expectations, with a strong internal customer mindset.
* Uses customer insights and data to influence and guide new infrastructure and automation offerings.
* Serves as a strategic partner to build, grow, and maintain long‑term, sustainable, and profitable relationships.


**CloudOps Core Competencies**
* Troubleshoot high‑complexity issues, including multi‑service and multi‑region incidents.
* Coordinate and troubleshoot issues involving 3rd‑party vendors, assisting in vendor relationship management.
* Provide guidance and mentoring to junior engineers on troubleshooting, design, and best practices.
* Share knowledge broadly (e.g., lunch‑and‑learns, mentoring, internal training, documentation).
* Perform as an individual contributor on high‑complexity tasks, owning them end‑to‑end.
* Act as primary point of contact for internal and cross‑tech (CTC) level projects in your domain.
* Help allocate work across individual contributors and identify when additional support is needed.
* Recognize when project timelines are at risk and partner with leadership to adjust scope or approach.
* Communicates progress, risks, and needs clearly to management and stakeholders.
* Contribute to an inclusive, collaborative, and respectful organizational culture.


 If you’re passionate about
 **Cloud Infrastructure** 
 , enjoy
 **building automation and tools** 
 , and are excited about applying
 **AI agents and orchestration to real‑world infrastructure problems** 
 , we’d love to talk to you.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Administrator
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Administrator for our COMOS PLM team, you will design and implement solutions that enable cost optimization, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement on our Azure platform, supporting approximately 800 users daily.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with internal and external platform team members, the IT Service Owner, business tool owners, and Microsoft Azure Cloud Solution Architects (CSAs) to build, secure, and maintain highly available, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure solutions. Your contributions will directly support Siemens Energy’s digital transformation and sustainable energy mission.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Design, implement, and support secure, scalable, and highly available Azure cloud environments while driving cloud modernization, performance improvements, and cost optimization initiatives.
* Automate infrastructure deployment and operational processes using Terraform, ARM Templates, and PowerShell to improve efficiency, consistency, and reliability.
* Ensure platform availability through proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, incident management, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
* Strengthen cloud security by implementing governance standards, identity protection, privileged access management, and Azure security best practices.
* Collaborate with architects, application owners, and global stakeholders to deliver robust cloud solutions while promoting operational excellence through automation, documentation, and process standardization.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, with 10\+ years of strong experience managing Microsoft Azure environments including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Load Balancers, NSGs, Availability Sets, and Recovery Services.
* Solid understanding of cloud architecture principles, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, ARM Templates, PowerShell), Git\-based CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across cloud infrastructure, Windows Server administration, networking, and enterprise IT operations.
* Experience with Azure security services, backup and disaster recovery solutions, business continuity planning, and proactive monitoring tools such as Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
* Good understanding of SQL Server fundamentals, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, and secure connectivity concepts.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in global, cross\-functional teams.
* A continuous learning mindset and passion for cloud technologies, automation, and operational excellence.


**About The Team**
 The COMOS PLM team supports a global Azure\-based platform used by hundreds of users across Siemens Energy. The team works closely with business stakeholders, platform experts, and Microsoft Azure specialists to deliver secure, reliable, and high\-performing cloud services.
   

  

 The environment promotes innovation, collaboration, automation, and continuous improvement, enabling the team to provide scalable digital solutions that support Siemens Energy’s global operations.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Working closely with business stakeholders, vendors, and cross\-functional technology teams, you will translate business needs into scalable, reliable, and secure technology solutions.
